instruction: Set up a local folder in Thunderbird with the name DRAFTS-OLD.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating one local folder (DRAFTS-OLD) in Thunderbird. The evaluator reuses the existing check_list metric function to verify that both the folder file and .msf index file exist using regex patterns. Note: The hyphen in the folder name should work correctly with regex pattern matching.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to create a local folder named 'DRAFTS-OLD' in Thunderbird
Postconfig appropriately uses 'ls -R' to list the Thunderbird Local Folders directory and captures output to cache file
Getter logic correctly uses get_cache_file to read the ls output
Metric check_list correctly searches for regex patterns line-by-line in the output

Expected regex patterns are semantically correct: Pattern 1 '\bDRAFTS-OLD\.msf\b' matches the .msf index file, Pattern 2 '\bDRAFTS-OLD/?(?!\.msf)' matches the folder file itself while excluding the .msf file using negative lookahead
Complete coverage: Evaluator checks both required components of a Thunderbird local folder (the folder file and the .msf index file)
Data flow is correct: ls output -> cache file -> check_list -> regex matching against expected patterns
No logical edge case issues: The regex patterns will correctly distinguish between the folder file and index file
